home.title: Levix Digital: software that runs inside your perimeter
home.description: Levix Digital builds products for documents, knowledge and software development that run on your own machines and network, under your control.
home.hero.headline: Software that runs inside your perimeter.
home.hero.lead: Levix Digital builds products for documents, knowledge and software development that run on your own machines and network, under your control. Your data is never sent to us.
home.products.title: Two lines of products, one rule: they run where you are
home.products.lead: Each product is installed and run by you. Its status says whether you can install it today.
home.about.title: Who we are
home.about.body1: Levix Digital develops products that run inside the customer's perimeter, never as a service hosted by us.
home.about.body2: We are an independent software company in Calgary, Alberta, Canada, where our research and development is done and our decisions are made.
home.about.body3: Our products are installed by the people who use them, keep their data on their own machines, and can be inspected.
home.research.title: LSIE: document extraction without guesswork
home.research.body: LSIE (Levi's Scale-Invariant Extraction) is a deterministic geometric method that finds the fields of a document even when its layout grows, shifts or changes scale. It runs locally, with no external calls, and powers DocMapper's extraction.
home.contact.title: Talk to us
home.contact.lead: Questions about a product, a partnership or a project: write to us.
